quality_gate: Every category and repetition must pass 100%; no relaxation
limitations: Recall latency includes query embedding and DB retrieval; excludes scoring, product HTTP and ProvisionRecord writes
Index and build metrics are per-case synthetic fixtures; no production-scale or approximate-index claim
Token budget uses UTF-8 bytes as a token estimate, not a tokenizer measurement
VRAM is whole-GPU; RAM peaks are sampled, not guaranteed continuous peaks
DB and OS caches are not reset; vector and result caches are disabled
